releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.10.7 - Continuous Connected Time + CPU Fix
releaseNotes:
• ⏱ CONTINUOUS CONNECTED TIME: a 1-day voucher activated yesterday now shows ~20h Connected (elapsed since activation, capped at validity) instead of only the current 38-minute session — the app reads the new [USED-UP:]/[BASE-UP:] tags the router now writes, with an automatic elapsed-time fallback for older vouchers.
• 🖥 ROUTER CPU FIX: profile Rate Limit is now cleared and bandwidth is shaped by ONE static PCQ queue (10.10.10.0/23) instead of one dynamic Simple Queue per logged-in user — the L009 no longer scales CPU with user count (0 dynamic queues verified on all online routers).
• 🚦 Lightened router schedulers (quota saver 60s, expire monitor 3m) to cut small-router CPU load.
• 📊 v1.10.6 preserved: real remaining quota/time on used vouchers, readable sales hero card, long-term voucher protection.
